_why: What BoardIntent.swift is graded on by intent_test.swift. 'development' was written first and is the set the rules were tuned on; 'held_out' was written at the same time, before any rule existed, and was never used to tune. Near misses are deliberately close: questions about what is on screen, positions in it ('from line 3'), building something from scratch, other whiteboards. A question whose subject is on the screen ('explain this from scratch') stays a normal answer by design: the board shows no screenshot, so it cannot teach what it cannot see.
